items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Our family came from a city in southern France called Pau. And our original name, Brunoix, B-R-U-N-O-I-X. So then that got to be B-R-U-N-O-I-S.

ctx.x: Brunious. Yeah. Our family came from a city in southern France called Pau. And our original name, Brunoix, B-R-U-N-O-I-X. So then that got to be B-R-U-N-O-I-S. But then it got kind of Americanized, Brunios, and then there were different forms of spellings after that, so that people could pull their magic act let’s call it. So it’s just, things just go like that. And sometimes it’s really tough to talk about because you’ve got people who say oh no, it didn’t go like that because everyone will believe whatever they…
Wow. Well I really don’t know a heck of a lot about how you got into this music, and I’d really enjoy finding out. I know your father was quite musical and a writer.
